stratification: logged FBG target (zero vs positive) x stop index

retrieval_corpus.scope: all validation contexts, including questions outside train/test

interpretation: missed_gain_rate bounds how often the logged FBG target under-states what continuing could have achieved; clipped_but_reachable_rate is the share of zero-target stops at which an alternative continuation still improves. Alternative rollouts use temperature 0.8, so they also carry decoding noise; the rate is an upper bound on support bias, not a point estimate.
